what: When you hover a button or link, the text line slides up 100% and blurs out, while the same text rises in from 100% below and turns on (.65s cubic-bezier(.165,.84,.44,1), blur .65s ease). It reverses on release. Everything outside the line is masked so the text appears to roll within a single line — quiet, minimalist-style buttons and notice rows
needs: CustomEase (when giving a curve as values)

options.--fx-dur · --fx-ease: (css variable) duration · position curve, default .65s · cubic-bezier(.165,.84,.44,1)
options.[data-fx-part=text] · [data-fx-part=clon: Original row made by the part and the cloned row (do not place directly)
options.look: once — each time you hover, the original row exits to −105% over .6s while fading (the original wrote expo.inout but GSAP doesn’t recognize it, so it runs the default power1.out — measured value kept as is), and the duplicate row comes up from the 150% standby spot to 105% over .4s (cubic-bezier(.115,.405,.24,1)) and stays there, changed. Releasing doesn’t reverse it, and hovering again restarts from the beginning (gsap required) · plain — no fade, the row just rolls into place (outside the row is hidden by a mask)
options.out · in · ease · out-ease: (look: once) drop-out and rise-in duration (s), rise-in curve, drop-out curve — defaults .6 · .4 · 0.115,0.405,0.24,1 · power1.out

from.where: shared.css .cm-roll (original textRotate — buttons · booking · Menu · notice line, text goes translateY 0→−100% · opacity 1→0, pseudo 100%→0 · 0→1, .65s cubic-bezier(.165,.84,.44,1), only above 834px)
shared.css·shared.js header menu·button·list row [data-fx~=roll-fade-label] look: once (original data-hover-animation, linkhover curve)

Header ONLINE SHOP · footer contact pill button .mo-btn — on hover the text moves up 20% while fading (btntxthidden), and the same text (::before data-txt) rises from 20% below to the −50% position and lights up (btntxtshow), both .4s cubic-bezier(.645,.045,.355,1). The original travels a shorter 20% · 30% and snaps straight back on release (one keyframe run)

.se-roll on all pages (lime · black button text) — original .cta-yellow: two copies of the text line roll at −100%·100% over .5s cubic-bezier(0,0,.2,1) and do not fade. Use this part as: data-fx-roll-fade-label="look: plain" style="--fx-dur: .5s; --fx-ease: cubic-bezier(0,0,.2,1)"
